gates.direction: observed return,fitted return,recent fitted return,fast MA bias,fast/slow MA spread all strictly positive
gates.state: existing steady_up or strengthening state;no score60 floor

forecast: Reuse archived centered return/safety predictions;no refit,new targets,weight tuning or positive-prediction gate. Maximin percentiles always use full86pool,not filtered gate
availability: Common full86pool,fitted dates for every new rule including simple controls;retain original frozen controls unchanged;no-selection is missing return,not zero cash
evaluation: Original primary horizon+1 and secondary5session clocks,nextclose entry,exit+20/60/120;full future pool required;secondary overlaps are descriptive
quality: Fraction of selected members with terminal price>entry and strictly more than half future closes above entry (ties half);also mean above-entry occupancy and signed log path efficiency;not investment win probabilities
selection_history: After current maximin lists were found short10/10down,medium10/10weakening,long6/10down:freeze two interpretable eligibility screens and same-gate sorting controls before examining their historical results. Reused history is not unseen OOS
scope: Three-horizon candidate diagnostic,not real fund returns or a certified investment strategy. No automatic production,trial snapshot or model promotion
